message:
- **You push it**, Instructions: Run each list export separately, Products → Export → All products, then the same on Orders, Customers, Discounts, Inventory, and Online Store → Themes → ⋯ → Download theme file. Anything over 50 records is emailed to the store owner as a link instead of downloading, so you end up with a pile of CSVs plus a theme .zip.
- **We pull it**, Instructions: Settings → Apps → Develop apps → Build apps in Dev Dashboard → Create app → in Access, tick the read-only scopes (read_products, read_orders and read_all_orders, read_customers, read_content, read_themes, read_files, read_discounts, read_inventory, read_metaobjects) → Release → Installs → Install app. Then copy the app's client ID and client secret, paste both into a one-time link at scrt.link, and email us that link.

Let me know if you would like to push this to us or have us pull it for you!
notes: Admin exports over 50 records are emailed to the store owner as links rather than downloading directly.
Pull coverage follows the granted read-only scopes.
